This paragraph exists so the page counts as a regular page and not as a thin one. It describes the fixture site in plain words, repeats a few ideas and adds enough sentences to pass the threshold of one hundred and fifty words of visible text. The inventory script removes navigation, header and footer before it counts, so only this main content matters here. A page inventory lists every address of a site with its status, its title, its description, its headings and its links. It helps to plan a new structure, to find pages nobody links to, to find duplicate titles and to see how deep a visitor has to click before reaching a page. The numbers in this fixture are small on purpose, so each test can name the exact page it expects in a finding. More words follow to stay safely above the limit: one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen fifteen sixteen seventeen eighteen nineteen twenty.
